screen_text: Lead off. PR title: Swap Algolia for Typesense in search-service. Author is Morgan Lu. Reviewers are Mira Chen and Ellison. Labels include search, perf, and priority. Summary: this PR replaces the Algolia client in apps/search-service with Typesense. Cuts p95 latency from 380ms to 90ms on the Phoenix benchmark. Also drops the dependency on Faker for test seeding — switched to msw handlers.
